fusions.name: Bolting Charge
fusions.desc: You rush up to the target, then a hard shoulder-charge deals 15 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Stampeding Swat
fusions.desc: Swats every enemy within 2 tiles for 4 damage. For 3 seconds after you use it, you move 12% faster.

fusions.name: Burst Forward
fusions.desc: A short burst of movement that carries you 5 tiles forward.

fusions.name: Running Start
fusions.desc: When you cover ground, your physical damage rises 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
